title: Assistance
notConnectedYet: Assistance will be built in P08.

policy.pending: The values in use are provisional and await owner approval.
policy.advisory: Scoring is advisory only; the final decision belongs to a human reviewer.
policy.scoreHidden: The detailed score is not shown to the applicant in this version.

explain.needSeverity: Need severity: household size and dependents against income per person.
explain.incomeToNeeds: Income compared with essential monthly needs.
explain.availableAssets: Only assets actually available for disposal.
explain.seriousness: Seriousness of steps: engagement status and its proof document.
explain.jobStability: Job stability: continuity months with the income source.

engine.excluded: Relatives' wealth, unreceived inheritance and restricted assets are never counted.

realIncome.fail: A real income source is required to complete scoring.

notWealthy.pass: Available assets are below the rule threshold.
notWealthy.fail: Available assets reached or exceeded the rule threshold.

noPrior.fail: Prior assistance exists and no exception is approved.

recommendations.notEligible: Advisory: insufficient eligibility indicated; human review decides.
recommendations.additionalReview: Advisory: further verification is needed before any decision.
recommendations.partial: Advisory: partial assistance may fit after review.
recommendations.full: Advisory: full assistance may fit after review.
recommendations.humanReview: Advisory: routed to a human reviewer with no automated decision.

flags.identityDuplicate: Identity fingerprint used in another application
flags.phoneDuplicate: Phone fingerprint used in another application
flags.rapidResubmission: Repeated submissions in a short window
flags.incomeObligationMismatch: Declared income and obligations are inconsistent

errors.invalidTransition: This status cannot be reached from the current one.
errors.appealUsed: An appeal may be submitted only once.

why.identity: To verify the applicant and prevent duplicates, without publishing any data.
why.income_proof: To estimate actual income against needs.
why.engagement_proof: To prove seriousness without collecting the other party's details.

documents.limits: Maximum 5 MB for images and 10 MB for PDF files.
documents.pdfNote: PDF files are checked for type and size only; no image processing is applied.
documents.private: Documents are private to the applicant and never appear in search, notifications or public logs.

rejection.incomeAboveThreshold: Declared income exceeds the currently approved threshold.
rejection.priorAssistance: Prior assistance is recorded for this applicant.
rejection.inconsistentInformation: Some information needs clarification before proceeding.

infoRequest.title: Information request
infoRequest.intro: We need a few clarifications to complete your review. This is not a rejection.

reasons.identityDocument: The document is unclear or incomplete; we need a clearer copy.
reasons.incomeProof: We need evidence for the stated monthly income.
reasons.engagementProof: We need proof of engagement status, with no details about the other party.
reasons.incomeFigure: We need confirmation of the stated income figure.
reasons.assetsFigure: We need confirmation of assets available for disposal.
reasons.obligationsFigure: We need confirmation of monthly obligations.

decision.title: Review outcome
decision.noScores: Detailed scores are not shown. The decision is human; automated scoring is advisory only.
decision.pendingDescription: Your application is still under review. The decision will appear here once issued.

appeal.title: Submit an appeal
appeal.window: You may appeal once within {{days}} days of the decision.
appeal.pending: Your appeal is being reviewed by a different reviewer.
appeal.used: You already appealed this application; a second appeal is not allowed.
appeal.closed: This application cannot be appealed now; the window closed or its status does not allow it.

validation.statementMin: Describe your appeal in at least 20 characters.
validation.statementMax: The appeal statement is too long (2000 characters max).

reference.label: Reference number
reference.demoNote: Demo number; the official one is minted server-side in P18.

program.title: Assistance programs
program.subtitle: Choose a suitable program. Every request is reviewed by a human; scoring is advisory only.
program.emptyDescription: Programs open for applications appear here. You can populate demo data from developer settings.
program.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching programs. Please retry.
program.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

conditions.title: Eligibility conditions
conditions.assetsRule: Available assets must be below {{value}} YER.
conditions.priorClosed: A second assistance is not granted; no exception is approved.
conditions.priorOpen: An exception may be considered under an independent policy.
conditions.appealWindow: Appeal window: {{days}} days from the decision date.

preCheck.title: Pre-check
preCheck.notStored: This pre-check is non-binding, never saved and never sent. It is an advisory estimate only.

mine.title: My applications
mine.subtitle: All your applications and their stages. Tap one for its timeline and actions.
mine.emptyDescription: Start a new application from the programs list; it will appear here with its reference number.
mine.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching your applications. Please retry.
mine.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

detail.title: Application details
detail.notFoundDescription: We could not find this application. It may have been deleted or the link is invalid.
detail.cancelConfirmDescription: The application will be cancelled and this cannot be undone.

wizard.fixErrors: Review the highlighted fields, then continue.

why.applicant: We ask for the minimum only. Your id and phone are converted to a fingerprint and never stored.
why.income: Actual income against needs is the basis — not relatives' wealth.
why.assets: Only assets available for disposal are counted. Restricted assets and unreceived inheritance are context only.
why.obligations: Living obligations show the real financial pressure on the household.
why.engagement: Engagement status and proof type are enough. We collect no details about the other party.
why.documents: Documents are uploaded privately; images are processed to drop location metadata before upload.
why.review: Review your data and declare it truthful. Publication consent is optional and revocable.
why.submit: After submission a reference number is issued and human review begins.

fields.availableAssetsHelp: Only this field enters the scoring.

fingerprints.note: We keep neither your id number nor your phone — only an encrypted fingerprint used to prevent duplicates.

documents.permission: Photo library permission was not granted.
documents.type: Unsupported file type. Allowed: JPG/PNG image or PDF.
documents.size: The file exceeds the allowed size.
documents.processing: Image processing failed, so nothing was uploaded — for your privacy.
documents.failed: Could not upload the document. Please try again.
documents.fingerprintNote: The current fingerprint is a demo metadata hash; content fingerprinting activates in P18.

review.truthful: I declare all information is truthful.
review.verification: I consent to verification of this information.
review.processing: I consent to processing my data for eligibility.
review.publication: I optionally consent to publishing my case anonymously.
review.publicationNote: Publication consent is entirely optional, never affects eligibility, and can be withdrawn anytime.

submit.intro: Submitting creates an official copy of your request and issues a reference number. No automated decision is made.

result.title: Application submitted
result.note: Keep the reference number. You can track the application from My applications.

validation.identity: Enter your id number so its fingerprint can be saved.
validation.phone: Enter your phone number so its fingerprint can be saved.
validation.amount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.

dev.title: Review simulator
dev.subtitle: Internal tool to run reviewer/finance transitions through the same workflow service. No automated decision in the user path.
dev.empty: No applications. Create a demo one to start.
dev.created: A demo application was created and submitted.
dev.noTransitions: No transitions available from this status.
dev.applied: Transition applied and recorded in the audit trail.
dev.notDemo: This simulator works in demo mode only.

catalog.title: Support & donation programs
catalog.subtitle: Donation intent is recorded here; money moves outside the app through a licensed provider only.
catalog.emptyDescription: Open programs appear here. You can populate demo data from developer settings.
catalog.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching programs. Please retry.

grant.label: Non-refundable grants
grant.description: Financial support that is not repaid, disbursed after human eligibility verification.

partial.label: Partial assistance
partial.description: Covers part of the costs based on need and available resources.

qardHasan.label: Qard Hasan
qardHasan.description: Information and referral to a licensed entity only. No lending or collection inside the app.

inKind.label: In-kind support
inKind.description: Furniture, appliances and textiles through Souk Khair, with no money inside the app.

donorContribution.label: Donor contributions
donorContribution.description: Individual donation intents directed to open programs via a licensed provider.

kind.title: Program kind
kind.note: The platform holds no funds, no wallet and no escrow. Any money transfer happens outside the app through a licensed provider.

detail.title: Program details
detail.notDonatable: This kind does not accept monetary donation intents inside the app.
detail.notOpen: This program is not open right now.
detail.notFoundDescription: We could not find this program. It may be closed or the link is invalid.

donate.title: Donation intent
donate.subtitle: Only the intent is recorded. No amount is charged inside the app and no card data is requested.
donate.anonymous: Hide my name from reports and public surfaces
donate.anonymousHelp: Anonymity does not prevent verification by the authorized finance entity, and never reveals any beneficiary identity.
donate.notice: This is an unconfirmed donation intent. It is never counted as received money and never enters public statistics.
donate.handoff: Register the intent with the provider
donate.simulateNote: Demo simulation of the provider confirmation only. It represents no real transfer and issues no receipt.
donate.verifiedNote: Final financial verification happens through an authorized entity on the server (P18). No receipt is issued before that.
donate.requirementsAction: What is needed for real wiring?

validation.amount: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
validation.min: The amount is below the program minimum.
validation.max: The amount exceeds the program maximum.

donations.title: My donations
donations.subtitle: Your intents and the confirmed ones. No amount is shown as received before financial verification.
donations.emptyDescription: Start from the programs list to record an intent; it will appear here with its honest status.
donations.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching your donations. Please retry.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.subtitle: A receipt is issued only after financial verification by an authorized entity.
receipts.emptyDescription: Receipts appear only for financially verified donations. Intents and provider confirmation issue no receipt.
receipts.demoNote: Demo receipt — not an official financial document

disbursements.title: Disbursement history
disbursements.subtitle: What was actually disbursed to you, with its honest status. Only you can see this history.
disbursements.emptyDescription: Disbursements appear here after a human reviewer approves your application and a payment proof is recorded.
disbursements.errorDescription: Something went wrong while fetching your disbursements. Please retry.
disbursements.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

status.paidRecorded: Disbursed with proof — awaiting your confirmation

disbursements.awaitingNote: A disbursement is not complete until you confirm it. A dispute returns it to financial review.
disbursements.capNote: Total disbursements never exceed your approved amount, and nothing is disbursed without a human reviewer different from the proposer.

validation.note: Write the dispute reason before submitting.

impact.title: Impact report
impact.subtitle: Real confirmed figures only, with a clear definition for every number.
impact.emptyDescription: No demo figure is shown here. Impact appears after real financial verification on the server (P18).
impact.realOnly: This report excludes demo data entirely, and withhold the amount whenever the count is below the threshold.
impact.noRealData: Every figure in demo mode is labeled and never presented as a real achievement.
impact.errorTitle: Could not load the impact report
impact.errorDescription: Something went wrong while computing impact. Please retry.
impact.notConnectedDescription: Backend wiring activates in P18. Demo mode is available now.

definitions.verifiedDonations: Count and total of real, financially verified donations only.
definitions.confirmedDisbursements: Count and total of real disbursements confirmed by the beneficiary only.
definitions.assistedCases: Number of real applications that received a beneficiary-confirmed disbursement.

requirements.title: Licensed provider requirements
requirements.subtitle: No real donation can be recorded before these requirements are met.
requirements.intro: The provider is not connected. No real donations are recorded and no receipts are issued until server-side wiring is complete.

items.licensed: A payment entity legally licensed in the target market, with a signed agreement.
items.agreement: A usage agreement defining responsibilities, any fees, and the refund policy.
items.keys: Provider keys stored server-side only — never in the app or the repository.
items.webhook: A server webhook with a verified signature to receive payment confirmation.
items.serverVerification: Financial verification and writing the verified status happen server-side only, with an audit trail.

requirements.note: Until then, demo mode runs with honest labels, and no demo figure enters public statistics.

reasons.rejected: The request did not meet disbursement conditions after human review.

dev.title: Disbursement simulator (Maker/Checker)
dev.subtitle: Internal tool to exercise the full disbursement cycle through the same domain service. Maker ≠ Checker is enforced in code.
dev.notDemo: This simulator works in demo mode only.
dev.noApplications: No applications. Create an approved one to start.
dev.applied: Transition applied and recorded in the audit trail.
dev.beneficiaryNote: Confirmation or dispute happens on the beneficiary screen, not here.
